## Personality

Odette Pullen is an unassuming, hardworking, dutiful, and sensible individual known for her steady nature. She possesses remarkable composure, remaining completely unshakeable in demeanor. Skilled academically, she achieved top marks in domestic science and aims to devote her life entirely to pedagogy while foreswearing marriage.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## History

Odette Pullen had a history of emotional dramatics, weeping heavily during the departure of her schoolmaster, Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), despite having spent four weeks insisting she would be glad to see him go. She also nearly drowned while reaching far out for water lilies on the [Lake of Glassy Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-glassy-waters), only saved when her sash was grabbed in time. In her youth, she participated in a dramatic play based on Tennyson's [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), playing the role of Guinevere. She was present during a reenactment of the tale alongside Isolde, and both girls experienced immense relief upon finding [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) alive after fearing she had drowned when her boat sank. Later, Odette and [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) picked up [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to escort them to the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Following the performance, Odette enjoyed supper with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde, and the group reflected cheerfully on the evening before departing together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ### [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)
